notes: Digital PDF; file bundles the blank question paper (pages 0-32) and a handwritten worked-solutions copy (pages 33-65) in which MCQ answers are circled in green and Section II is worked in pink ink. Solutions are transcribed from the handwriting; the paper gives no marking criteria, so marks_breakdown is null. Typos in the paper (left as printed): Q23(b) says the graph of A = 16x - x^2 but the plotted curve is A = 16x - 2x^2 (fix: 16x - 2x^2); Q32 has no closing question mark; Q33(b) 'bottles with cols' (cola); Q41 'The bearings of town T3' (bearing) and 'km. as shown'; Q22(a) 'most frequently used' interpreted as highest degree per guideline. In the handwritten Q32 solution the school wrote '1600 = k/80'; transcribed as 80 = k/1600 (correct). Q39 curve annotation: cut separates {A,B,D} from {E,C}; pipe E to B (12) runs backwards so is not counted (green note 'this is not included'). Handwritten solution pages also show annotated Q20 and Q30 diagrams (not cropped; working only). Standard 2 paper: old_syllabus/standard_topic left empty. Section I = 15 marks (Q1-15), Section II = 85 marks (Q16-41); Q16-29 total 48 as printed.
